book_title: The Kephalaia of the Grand Man: Twelvefold Architecture of the Coptic Substrate
structural_principle: The corpus unfolds as the Grand Man read in 3×4×5: three discrete degrees (celestial, spiritual, natural) crossed by four directions (East/will, South/wisdom, North/rational, West/ultimates), with five-fold constitution operating radially within each of the twelve resulting positions. The teaching atoms move from the foundational dualism of two substances at the celestial inmost, through the four-fold and five-fold articulations of cosmic descent, the twelvefold completeness of the spiritual man, the cosmic operations of redemption (wars, salvations, judges, thrones, and the Living Spirit's building of the natural cosmos), the cosmic purifications of the natural register, and finally to the consummation in the body-soul of the regenerate human at the natural ultimates. The corpus is framed by the Two Substances doctrine (T1, T55, T103) and closed by the identification of the cosmic Yes-and-Amen with the Call and the Hearing (T104). The repeated cosmos-as-body teachings (T38, T71, T81) and the recurring 'beforehand' pattern of providence (T46-T48) function as architectural ribs across the body. The five-fold constitution is the most robust empirical pattern, present at every position; the twelve-fold appears at specific positions where completeness must be articulated; the three-fold structure governs the macro-degrees and recurs as 'fullness of process' at every register.

grand_man_architecture.assessment: The 3×4 Grand Man hypothesis is strongly supported by the corpus's macro-structure: a clear celestial-spiritual-natural progression organized in twelve content-clusters, with five-fold constitution operating robustly at every position. The directional rotation (East=will, South=wisdom, North=rational, West=ultimates) maps naturally onto the four sub-cycles within each degree. However, the data show a significant asymmetry: Part 12 (Natural West) contains 34 teachings while Parts 1-3 each contain only 3. This is itself a meaningful structural feature, not a defect — it reflects the doctrine that ultimates are where heaven exists in concrete form, where the most explicit teaching is required, and where the regenerative work actually plays out in body, senses, and soul. The five-fold constitution is the most robust pattern in the data, exceeding even the twelvefold in frequency and explicitness; it confirms that 'five' operates as constitution (radial structure) rather than as part-count (linear structure). The twelvefold appears precisely where the Grand Man thesis would predict: at the moments of complete articulation (twelve aeons in the spiritual man, twelve dignities, twelve greatnesses, twelve judges, twelve thrones, twelve members of the body, twelve zodia). The corpus therefore confirms the prior architecture while refining it: 12 positions × 5 constitution × 3 degrees, with the natural West expanded to bear the weight of ultimates.
grand_man_architecture.twelve_part_structure: Twelve parts is the natural fit for this corpus. The teaching atoms cluster into exactly twelve content-coherent groups when traced by spiritual arc rather than by length. The chapter numbering preserved in the source manuscript runs to roughly 120 chapters, which the 104 teaching atoms compress into twelve macro-arcs. Each of the twelve parts has a distinct organizing principle (foundational dualism; four-fold articulation; five-fold descent; twelve-fold completeness; cosmic time/wars; Father's inmost; likenesses/judges/thrones; Living Spirit's building; plagues/purification; senses/body/grief; sun/moon/zodiac; body extended/soul/consummation), and each maps coherently to a Grand Man position by direction and degree. The size asymmetry between parts (3 to 34 teachings) is real but does not break the twelvefold — it reflects the natural concentration of teaching matter at ultimates.

three_degrees.description: Parts 1-4 (T1-T15) treat the inmost: the two substances and their structures (Part 1), the four-fold and five-fold articulations of divine descent (Part 2), the five Fathers as discrete degrees of accommodation (Part 3), and the twelve-fold completeness of the spiritual man (Part 4). Here are concentrated the foundational doctrines of the Father of Greatness, the Mother of Life, the Five Sons of the First Man, and the twelve aeons. The celestial register is articulated through dualism, four-fold articulation, five-fold emanation, and twelve-fold completeness — the four directions of the head.

Parts 5-8 (T16-T40) treat the operative middle: the cosmic ages and wars (Part 5), the Father's inmost considered through Land of Light, Eternity, and Hyle's counterpart (Part 6), the rational discernment of likenesses, judges, and thrones (Part 7), and the Living Spirit's actual building of the cosmic body (Part 8). This is where Divine Truth proceeds outward as redemptive operation: descent, structuring, judgment, and bearing-up. The Pillar of Glory, the Third Ambassador's image, and the cosmic anatomy belong here.

Parts 9-12 (T41-T104) treat the ultimates: the will of purification through plagues and the sorting work of fire and wheel (Part 9), the wisdom of senses, body, and the Mother's grief (Part 10), the rational illumination through sun, moon, and zodiac (Part 11), and the consummating ultimates of body extended, the pearl, the three icons, the daily purification, and the final synthesis on Two Substances and Yes/Amen (Part 12). This is where regeneration actually plays out — in the body of flesh, in the senses, in the daily food, in the soul's ascent through the luminaries.

four_directions.description: East at each degree treats foundation, primal disposition, and the will-register of redemptive action: foundational dualism (Part 1), cosmic ages and wars/salvations as the Lord's saving will (Part 5), and the will of purification through plagues and the three eternal works (Part 9).

South at each degree treats the wisdom-articulation of structure: four-fold and five-fold articulations of the cosmic descent (Part 2), the Father's inmost wisdom and Eternity (Part 6), and the wisdom of senses, body, and the mother's grieving wisdom (Part 10).

North at each degree treats the rational mapping and discrimination: the five Fathers as a chain of rational accommodation (Part 3), the discernment-doctrine of likenesses, judges, and thrones (Part 7), and the rational illumination through sun, moon, and zodiac (Part 11).

West at each degree treats the ultimates: the spiritual man as celestial-in-form (Part 4), the cosmic body as spiritual-in-form (Part 8), and the human body and consummation as natural-in-form (Part 12). Each West is where the prior three directions of its degree are gathered into ordered ultimates.

deviations: Part 12 (Natural West) contains 34 teachings while Parts 1-3 each contain only 3 teachings. The size asymmetry is significant — the natural ultimates carry roughly one-third of the total teaching matter. This is not a defect of the hypothesis but a real feature: ultimates are where heaven actually exists in concrete form, where the regenerative work plays out in body, senses, and soul, and where the most explicit teaching is required.

Several teachings have ambiguous numerical signatures (T18 titled 'Four Salvations' but counting five; T5 titled 'Five Faces' but counting four). This ambiguity is itself doctrinal: the four-fold and five-fold often interpenetrate, with four as ordered fullness in extension and five as the radial constitution within extension.

The four directions are not explicitly named in the corpus — they must be inferred from content (will, wisdom, rational, ultimates). The corpus speaks of 'four climes' (T4, T98), 'four winds' (T24, T47), and 'four faces' (T5), confirming a four-fold directional structure but not naming it as east/south/north/west.

The chapter numbering preserved in the source manuscript runs to roughly 120, suggesting that the underlying text once had more sub-divisions than the 104 teaching atoms here. Some of the teachings are clearly amalgamations of sub-chapters that have been gathered into single arcs (e.g., T15's twelve greatnesses, T44's three dwellings + twelve works).

Several teachings are heavily damaged (T1, T80, T95, T96, T102, T104) and their precise placement carries lower confidence. The fragments are nonetheless structurally meaningful and have been retained.

The 'beforehand' pattern of providence (T46-T48) functions as a meta-structural element that crosses the directional boundaries: it asserts that every separating operation in the natural was prepared by the Father before its crisis, which reflects the celestial source operating throughout the natural register.

The teaching of Two Substances appears at three positions (T1 in Celestial East, T55 in Natural South, T103 in Natural West) — framing the corpus and recapitulating the foundational dualism at multiple registers. This is a structural rib rather than a deviation.

T15 ('Twelve Greatnesses arranged as five') is itself a meta-statement of the Grand Man hypothesis — it explicitly says that the twelve are realized through five. This is direct internal evidence for 5×something at the celestial west position.

The will of love (East) at the celestial degree begins with the recognition of two substances and their structured opposition.

This is the celestial East: the inmost will of the Lord recognized as love-against-self-love, the foundational disposition out of which everything else emanates.

The progression moves from the Father's inmost structure through the celestial state into eternity, and then turns to the corrupt counterpart and the measure of cosmic time, ending with the doctrine that every great emanation issues from one of the Father's five faculties.
fivefold_evidence: T20: First Father established in his FIVE Members of light, with FIVE attributes gushing forth (Light, Fragrance, Voice, ...)
T23: Hyle's FIVE corrupt elements (smoke, fire, wind, water, darkness) as the inverted five-fold matrix

T25: FIVE emanations called forth from the Father's FIVE Members (Beloved of Lights from mind, Mother of Life from thought, Beloved from teaching, Virgin of Light from counsel, fifth from reflection) — the most direct expression of five-fold radial constitution at the divine source
T21: Land of Light constituted by five-fold members of the rich gods
parts.prior_alignment: Strongly confirms Spiritual South: the wisdom-register of the Father in operation is articulated five-fold in his very interior, and even his corrupt counterpart Hyle is structured five-fold in inversion.
parts.description: The wisdom-register of the spiritual degree, where the Father is contemplated in his inmost: his Five Members and Twelve Wisdoms (T20), his Land of Light in perfect order (T21), his unchanging Eternity (T22). Set against this is the corrupt counterpart Hyle's self-begetting (T23) and the long measure of cosmic time (T24), closed by the doctrine that the Father's great emanations all issue from his Five Members (T25). This is the wisdom of the inmost Divine considered in itself and in its first proceeding.

parts.title: Likenesses, Judges, and Thrones — Rational Discrimination in Operation
parts.body_region: arms / sides — rational discernment in operation
parts.organizing_principle: These five teachings articulate the rational discrimination at the spiritual degree: T26 gives Three Likenesses of the one redemption (parables of First Man, Living Spirit, Ambassador); T27 anatomizes the King of Darkness as Five Forms in inverted Grand Man; T28 enumerates the Twelve Judges sent from Greatness; T29 maps the Twelve Thrones of Glory; T30 describes the Three Garments of the Living Spirit. The progression moves from rational parable through five-fold inverted anatomy, through twelvefold judicial discrimination, to the discriminative clothing of operative power.
fivefold_evidence: T27: FIVE Forms in body of King of Darkness (lion-head, eagle-wings, demon-feet, dark belly, fish-loins) — the inverted Grand Man
T28: Twelve Judges proceeding from one Father, articulated as FIVE pairs across three cosmic ages with consummating gathering
T30: Three Garments (wind, fire, water) holding within them the FIVE-fold operative structure
parts.prior_alignment: Confirms Spiritual North as rational discrimination: discrimination operates through five-fold structures (King of Darkness's anatomy, judges' five-fold pairs) within twelve-fold articulation.
parts.description: The rational discrimination at the spiritual degree, working through likenesses, judges, and thrones: three parables of the one redemption, the five-fold inverted anatomy of the King of Darkness, the twelve great judges sent from the Greatness, the twelve thrones in the aeons and within the cosmos, and the three garments by which the Living Spirit clothes himself to subdue the natural.

parts.title: The Living Spirit's Cosmogonic Work and the Anatomy of the Cosmic Body
parts.body_region: lower thorax / abdomen — ultimates of spiritual register
parts.organizing_principle: These ten teachings articulate the ultimates of the spiritual degree, where the Living Spirit performs the actual building of the cosmos: T31 traces the Call's descent through the members of the Living Soul; T32 enumerates the Seven Works of the Living Spirit; T33 names the Five Structures built into the bodies of strong archons; T34 continues with the Builder's other works; T35 describes the Four Works of the Ambassador's revealing; T36 details the Mirror-Wheel before the King of Honor; T37 nests the Three Zones; T38 displays the Cosmos as a captive body with Five Watch-Stations; T39 narrates Adam's molding from the Watchers' children's bones; T40 maps the soul's twelvefold binding and release in the body. This is the Living Spirit's complete building activity, from descent through anatomy.
fivefold_evidence: T31: FIVE faculties (mind, thought, teaching, counsel, reflection) sent forth after the Call
T33: FIVE great structures built in the bodies of strong archons (disc on Omophoros, Pillar, Gehennas, pillars in great sea, four walls)
T36: FIVE Men of Radiance as the middle seal filling the Zone of the Wheel
T38: FIVE divine watch-stations (Pherokatochos, King of Honor, Adamas of Light, King of Glory, Omophoros) corresponding to the five faculties — the cosmic body explicitly five-fold
T40: soul's FIVE faculties bound in FIVE somatic substrates (bone, sinew, vein, flesh, skin); the New Man with FIVE virtues placed in five faculties
parts.prior_alignment: Strongly confirms Spiritual West: the most concentrated five-fold register in the corpus, where the Living Spirit's building is explicitly articulated through five-fold structures at every step.
parts.description: The ultimates of the spiritual degree, where the Living Spirit performs the actual cosmogonic work: descent of the Call through the members of the Living Soul; seven works of building and five structures embedded in the conquered archons; the Builder's continuing works and the Ambassador's four-fold revealing; the mirror-Wheel of judgment, the three nested Zones, the cosmos shaped as a captive body with five watch-stations, Adam molded from the Watchers' children's bones, and the soul's twelvefold binding and release within the body of flesh.

parts.title: The Three Plagues and the Cosmic Purification
parts.body_region: hips / loins — will of purification in ultimates
parts.organizing_principle: These ten teachings articulate the will-register of the natural degree, where purification is the Lord's saving will operating in ultimates: T41 lays out the Three Days of Life and the Two Deaths; T42 names Three Eternal Works at the consummation; T43 traces Three Plagues against the Enemy across cosmic ages; T44 describes Three Dwellings stripped from the archons; T45 follows the Three Mighty Ones poured down to earth and recovered; T46 details the Living Spirit's purification through three formative acts; T47 unfolds the pre-fashioned containments (the 'beforehand' pattern); T48 extends the foresight to every separating operation; T49 binds the archonic host onto the Star-Wheel; T50 describes the Three Wells of influx. Three-fold framing predominates, but with five-fold radial articulation at every step.
fivefold_evidence: T44: Three Dwellings stripped from archons but with twelve great works of cosmic economy resting on FIVE-fold purification of perception/will/natural-truth
T49: Star-Wheel as one of Four Great Works with FIVE-fold archonic distribution from the Five Worlds
T50: Three Wells, with the second summons reaching the FIVE likenesses of trees and the third summons reaching the FIVE worlds of flesh
T46: Living Spirit's purification working through three formative acts that touch the FIVE elements
parts.prior_alignment: Confirms Natural East: the will of purification in ultimates is articulated three-fold (the cosmic ages, the wars, the plagues, the dwellings, the wells) with five-fold radial structure within each three.
parts.description: The will-register of the natural degree, where the Lord's saving love operates as purification: three days set against two deaths, three eternal works at the consummation, three plagues against the Enemy, three dwellings of water/darkness/fire stripped from the archons, three Mighty Ones poured down and drawn up, the Living Spirit's three-fold purifying clothing, the providence of pre-fashioned containments, the binding of the archonic host on the Star-Wheel, and the three Wells of influx by which heaven and earth communicate.

parts.title: Senses, Body, and Cosmic Sorrow — Wisdom in Ultimates
parts.organizing_principle: These ten teachings articulate the wisdom-register of the natural degree: T51 distinguishes the Wheel from the heavens by their pneumatic substance; T52 names three discrete degrees of emanation (gods, rich-men, angels); T53 enumerates the Five Garments of the First Man and the soul's two garments at death; T54 shows the Light extracted from Hyle's storehouses; T55 gives the Two Essences and the Firmaments as a built palace; T56 describes the molding of Adam and Eve after the stolen icon; T57 maps the body as a city of sense-storehouses; T58 explains why the first generations lived so long; T59 names the Three Griefs of the Mother of Life; T60 traces the Four Weepings of the First Man's garments. The progression moves from cosmic structure (T51-55) through the molding of the body (T56-58) into divine sorrow over the captive Living Soul (T59-60).
fivefold_evidence: T53: FIVE Garments of First Man (wind, water, light, air, fire) + soul's two garments at death
T54: FIVE storehouses of Hyle's elements emptied of captive light
T57: FIVE Senses with their storehouses (eye, ear, smell, taste, touch) governed by the heart-king as cellarer — the body as city of memory
T58: FIVE Lords of the sphere (year, month, day, hour, moment) governing five descending generations of human life
T60: FIVE Sons / Five Garments of First Man weeping three times + a fourth weeping = four total weepings of the five-fold structure
parts.prior_alignment: Confirms Natural South: senses, body, and lifespans are all structured five-fold at the natural register, reproducing the celestial five faculties in ultimate form.
parts.description: The wisdom-register of the natural degree: the wheel that turns within the heavens without cleaving them; gods, rich-men, and angels as three discrete degrees of emanation; the five garments of the First Man and the soul's two garments; the light extracted from Hyle's storehouses; the two essences and the firmaments built as a palace for the king; the molding of Adam and Eve after the stolen icon; the body as city of sense-storehouses ruled by the heart; the descent of human lifespan through five lords; and the cosmic sorrows of the Mother of Life and the First Man's weeping garments over the captive Living Soul.

parts.title: Hidden and Revealed — Sun, Moon, Fire, and the Twelve Zodia
parts.body_region: knees / lower legs — rational illumination in ultimates
parts.organizing_principle: These ten teachings articulate the rational illumination at the natural degree: T61 distinguishes hidden and revealed members (the Father hidden, the luminaries and tongue revealed); T62 describes the First Man clothed in the elements for war; T63 names Three Rocks of Glory; T64 gives the cosmic origin of love and hatred; T65 enumerates Three Things shown to Adam plus seven reasons; T66 reads the sun as likeness of the First Greatness with seven goods vs seven wickednesses of night; T67 reads the daily sunrise/sunset as the two great visible mysteries; T68 elaborates the Ambassador's work in the sun; T69 enumerates the Five Works of Fire; T70 binds the Twelve Zodia in the sphere from the Five Worlds. The progression moves from hidden/revealed members through cosmic origins, through the daily reading of sun and moon as visible icons of redemption, into the cyclic binding of the zodiac.
fivefold_evidence: T62: First Man clothed in FIVE elements for war (fire, wind, water, light, air)
T67: FIVE works of the sun (light, beauty, peace, releasing the Living Soul, power-and-taste in the Cross of Light)
T69: FIVE Works of Fire (releases/burns wood, separates four likenesses, gives taste, molds vessels, manifests light)
T70: Twelve Zodia molded from the FIVE Worlds of Darkness — two zodia per world; FIVE wandering stars correlated with five elements
T75 (in Part 12): Eight Places of Living Fire continuing the five-fold theme
parts.prior_alignment: Confirms Natural North as rational illumination: sun, fire, and zodiac are explicitly structured through five at every level.
parts.description: The rational illumination of the natural degree: the body's hidden and revealed members as likeness of Father, luminaries, and tongue; the First Man clothed in elements for war; the three Rocks of Glory; the cosmic origin of love as bond of the Greatness and hatred as first death; three things shown to Adam — icon, mold, knowledge; the sun as visible likeness of the First Greatness; the daily mystery of sunrise and sunset; the Ambassador's work read in the sun; the five works of fire; and the twelve zodia bound in the sphere from the five worlds of darkness.

parts.title: The Body Extended, the Soul, and the Consummation — Ultimates of Ultimates
parts.organizing_principle: These thirty-four teachings articulate the consummating ultimates of the natural degree, where the entire prior architecture is realized in the regenerate human and in the daily, bodily, soul-life of the elect. The arc moves through several waves: the cosmic body extended (T71); the gathering ladder and the names of the one garment (T72-73); Hyle's envy and the eight places of Living Fire (T74-75); the Apostle's letter of peace and the kingdoms of the world (T76-78); daily purification and the heavenly prosopon (T79-80); the pearl in the sea and the soul's ascent (T81-83); the elements bound to the Cross of Light and the cloud (T84-86); the three begettings of flesh and the dragon's twelve openings (T87-88); the reflected face and the body's five offspring (T89-90); the luminaries' two sorrows and the word as five-minted coin (T91-93); the Pentecost of the soul (T94); the eye and senses (T95-96); the five-fold cosmos and the gates of firmaments (T97-98); the three icons in the righteous man (T99); the threefold prayer of the First Man (T100); pruning and mystical seeing (T101-102); and the closing summary of the Two Substances and the Yes-Amen as Call-Hearing (T103-104). The size of this part reflects the doctrine that ultimates are where the most explicit teaching is required.
fivefold_evidence: T71: FIVE Watches in the cosmic body (Pherokatochos, King of Honor, Adamas, King of Glory, Omophoros) — the body explicitly five-fold
T73: FIVE noeric ones / body of the Pillar of Glory as five-fold completeness of Divine Truth
T81: pearl from the sea — drops fall through the FIVE-fold cosmic structure of element-into-oyster
T87: three begettings of flesh organized by where Hyle's enthumesis is seated within the FIVE worlds
T88: twelve openings of the dragon = seven sense-organs + FIVE caves of body below
T90: FIVE Offspring of the body's food (breath, voice, discharge, seed, somatic child)
T92: word as FIVE-minted coin formed by FIVE artisans = five faculties
T94: FIVE Garments × FIVE Powers = twenty characters in twenty members
T97: FIVE-fold whole cosmos that cannot stand if one is missing; FIVE Great Matters revealed by the Apostle
T99: Three Icons (pneumatic, psychic, somatic) consummated by the Virgin of Light at the FIVE-fold soul-cycle
T100: Threefold prayer met by threefold sending across the FIVE Greatnesses (Father, Mother+First Man, Living Spirit, Ambassador, Jesus the Radiance)
parts.prior_alignment: Confirms Natural West as ultimate of ultimates with significant size asymmetry (34 teachings vs 3-10 in other parts). The asymmetry is itself doctrinal: ultimates carry the weight of teaching matter, and five-fold constitution is saturated throughout this part.
parts.description: The consummating ultimates of the natural degree, where the entire prior architecture comes to rest in the daily life of the regenerate human. The cosmos is shown as the body of man extended; the elements gather upward through the column of accumulated truth; the many names of the one Garment are gathered into one; Hyle's envy is exposed at four registers; the Living Fire is named at eight stations; the Apostle's letter of peace seals the elect against the four kingdoms and the five works of Sin; the soul is daily purified, the pearl molded in the sea, the soul lifted by the two luminaries through eight paths; the elements bound to the Cross of Light cast off twelve strippings; clouds rise as signs of falsity exposed; the three begettings of flesh and the twelve openings of the dragon are named; the reflected face teaches Call and Hearing; the five offspring of food are read; the luminaries grieve over the captive soul; the word is minted as a coin by five artisans; the Pentecost is the eating of Call-and-Answer; the eye is read as microcosm; the five-fold cosmos cannot stand without one of its parts; the three icons (pneumatic, psychic, somatic) are consummated by the Virgin of Light; the threefold prayer of the First Man is met by threefold sending; pruning teaches the discrete degrees of pain; mystical seeing teaches the loosening of soul from body; and the corpus closes by returning to the Two Substances and identifying the cosmic Yes and Amen with the Call and the Hearing — the ultimate frame within which all prior teaching has been spoken.

chapters.title: The Mingling and the Molding of Adam
chapters.description: Opening fragment narrating the cosmic clash between Light and Darkness, the mingling, Hyle's bringing-forth, the molding of Adam in the Deep, and the opening of his eyes. Although heavily damaged, this teaching establishes the foundational scene of the proprium's first formation in the mingled state and grounds the corpus's whole drama.

chapters.title: The Two Trees as Five-Membered Organisms of Life and Death
chapters.description: The architectural insight that Life and Death are corresponding structures, each a tree with five members (reflection, counsel, teaching, thought, mind), the same faculties bearing Jesus as fruit in the Beautiful Tree and inverting downward into the bolos in the Bitter Tree. Establishes five-fold constitution as the basic architecture.

chapters.title: The Triad of Goodness, Wisdom, and Power at Three Discrete Degrees
chapters.description: The triad of foundational principles — Eudaimonia, Sophia, Power — repeats at three discrete degrees: Father, cosmos of aeons, elements. At the elemental register, Power is the Five Sons of the First Man bearing up the All. Establishes the three-fold descent that will govern the macro-degrees of the corpus.

chapters.title: The Four Great Days and Their Twelve-fold Fullness
chapters.description: The four great Days — Father, Third Ambassador, Pillar of Glory, Jesus the Radiance — each with twelve-hour fullness, mirrored by Four Nights with twelve shadows each. The Pillar's twelve hours are the Five Sons of First Man + Five Sons of Living Spirit + Call/Hearing. The wisdom-articulation of cosmic descent in its complete fourfold extension.

chapters.title: The Four Faces of Light Set Against Four of Darkness
chapters.description: Four operative Faces of Light (First Man, Third Ambassador, Jesus the Radiance, Great Counsel) sent forth from the Father with their trees, statures, ships; matched by four Counterparts of Darkness. The wreath of light is fixed in the fourth Face among the five elements — five-fold constitution within four-fold articulation.

chapters.title: The Anatomy of the Five Worlds of Darkness
chapters.description: Complete five-fold anatomy of the proprium: five archons, five spirits, five bodies, five tastes, five trees molded, with the King of Darkness as composite beast-body. The negative mirror of the Five Storehouses; self-love articulated in every direction. The most explicit five-fold register at the celestial-south position.

chapters.title: The Five Fathers as Discrete Degrees of Accommodation
chapters.description: The chain of five Fathers — Father of Greatness → Third Ambassador → Jesus the Radiance → Mind of Light → Form of Light — each producing a triad of operative powers. The Form of Light meets the soul leaving the body and clothes it with garments of light. Five-fold accommodation as the rational map of divine descent.

chapters.title: The Ten Chariots of Jesus the Son
chapters.description: Jesus the Son of the Greatness mounts ten chariots in succession to descend into the cosmos: vessel of light, chariot of First Man, Pillar of Glory, Call, Answer, and the five living elements (Air, Wind, Light, Water, Fire). Five-fold structural vehicles plus five-fold living elements.

chapters.title: The Five Mysteries by Which the First Man Returned
chapters.description: Five everyday gestures (peace, salutation, kiss, right hand, chirotonia) revealed as the five mysteries by which the First Man went out to battle, was raised home, and by which every soul is welcomed at death. Five-fold articulation enacted three times: descent, return, individual redemption.

chapters.title: The Spiritual Man as Microcosm of the Twelve Aeons
chapters.description: The Twelve Great Aeons of Light reproduced as members in the regenerate man: five faculties (mind, thought, teaching, counsel, reflection) joined with Calling and Hearing make seven, indwelt by the Living Spirit and centered on the Ambassador. T11 traces the litany of origins: every class of good has its specific divine source from Father of Lights down to Mind of Light.

chapters.title: The Foundations and Awakeners of the Mind of Light
chapters.description: Five Foundational Sayings (T12) form the doctrinal ground upon which the Mind of Light is established: unnameable Father, Ambassador/Father of Life, living law, Mother sending the king to Enmity, all as one living body. Five Drawers-Upward (T13) constitute the architecture of resurrection — five discrete operations of raising answering to the five faculties.

chapters.title: The Twelve Dignities of the Cosmos of Death and the Twelve Greatnesses Reaching Adam
chapters.description: The cosmos of death built from Death's five pourings, producing the five worlds of flesh and twelve spirits of error from the zodiac (T14). Set against this, the Twelve Greatnesses arranged as five — the descent of Divine Truth from the hidden Father through Mother of Life/First Man, Living Spirit, Third Ambassador, and Jesus the Radiance, reaching down to Adam and Eve's flesh and home in the Last Andrias (T15). The most direct internal evidence for 5×something articulation.

chapters.title: The Three Cosmic Ages of Redemption
chapters.description: The whole spiritual drama divided into three discrete ages: descent and return of First Man (greatest); building of cosmos by Living Spirit and Mother of Life (least); revealing work of Third Ambassador down to Panaretos's ascent (middle). The macro-timeline of redemption in three-fold fullness of process.

chapters.title: The Four Wars and the Four Salvations
chapters.description: Four successive wars (T17) waged by Sons of Light against Sons of Darkness — descent of First Man, structuring by Living Spirit, revealing by Ambassador, glorifying by Jesus. The same pattern as four/five salvations (T18): each war's positive saving operation. T18 is titled 'Four Salvations' but counts five — explicit evidence of five-fold radial structure within four-fold framing.

chapters.title: What Greatness Truly Is
chapters.description: Greatness defined as the Great Land — the bearing realm in which all gods, angels, and dwelling-places stand established. The Father is the first who stands fast within it. This Father–Greatness pattern repeats at five registers: Father, Ambassador, Radiance, Pillar, five holy gods. Foundation for understanding every subsequent reference to 'Greatness' in the corpus.

chapters.title: The First Father in His Five Members
chapters.description: The First Father established in his Five Members of light (the five intellectual faculties as the inmost articulation of the Divine itself), with twelve members of light identified as the twelve Wisdoms. Five attributes (Light, Fragrance, Voice, ...) gush forth from him into the aeons, sealing and nourishing every state. The most explicit five-fold articulation of the Divine source.

chapters.title: The Land of Light and the Stillness of Eternity
chapters.description: The Land of Light as the celestial state in its perfect order (T21): living ambrosia, beautiful members, summoned from the Father, dwelling established in him, no admixture of falsehood or death. Eternity as the unchanging stillness of the Father (T22): standing before and unto eternity, the inmost celestial unrevealable in ultimates.

chapters.title: Hyle's Self-Begetting and the Measure of Cosmic Time
chapters.description: The corrupt counterpart of the Mother of Life: Hyle's self-begetting in five elements (smoke, fire, wind, water, darkness) producing trees, fruits, and worlds without conjunction (T23). The unmeasurable Father set against the countable measures of cosmic time, ending in the four-fold sequence of war, building, standing, and final release (T24).

chapters.title: The Father's Emanations from His Five Members
chapters.description: Compact doctrine of how each great emanation (Beloved of Lights, Mother of Life, Beloved, Virgin of Light, fifth) issues from one of the Father's five intellectual faculties (mind, thought, teaching, counsel, reflection). The most direct expression of five-fold radial constitution at the divine source.

chapters.title: Three Likenesses of the One Redemption
chapters.description: Three parables answering one question: First Man as famous man whose sons were taken (descent); Living Spirit as wise craftsman and warrior in a furnace-ship (structuring and rescue); Third Ambassador as great man recovering wealth and captives in foreign country (awakening). Three discrete registers of one redemptive work.

chapters.title: The Five Forms in the King of Darkness
chapters.description: The King of Darkness anatomized as inverted Grand Man with five bestial members corresponding to the Five Worlds of Darkness: lion-head (fire-tyranny), eagle-wings (smoke-arrogance), demon-feet (smoke-falsity), dark-belly (darkness-appetite), fish-loins (water-submerged truth). His body iron and bronze cannot pierce; his life is the bile of wrath.

chapters.title: The Twelve Judges and the Twelve Thrones
chapters.description: Twelve great judges sent from the Father (T28) — First Man, Living Spirit, Mother of Life, ... King of Honor, Ambassador, Radiance, ... judge in the air, Last Andrias — each performing a distinct discrimination. The corresponding twelve thrones (T29) — nine outer thrones in the aeons of Greatness mirrored by nine inner thrones inside the cosmos, ending at the Judge of Truth in the air. Twelve-fold articulation of divine discrimination.

chapters.title: The Three Garments of the Living Spirit
chapters.description: When the Living Spirit comes to make the cosmos he clothes himself in three garments — wind, fire, water (perception, will, natural truth) — to subject the works of darkness above and below; he then strips them off, scatters their contents for purification, and conveys the refined remainder upward through the Zone.

chapters.title: The Call's Descent Through the Members of the Living Soul
chapters.description: The First Man as head with members of the Living Soul hung upon him; the Pillar of Glory beneath; the Father above clothed in the Virgin of Light. The five faculties (mind, thought, teaching, counsel, reflection) sent forth after the Call to track and gather the dispersed Living Soul into the icon of the Father.

chapters.title: The Seven Works of the Living Spirit and the Five Structures in the Bound Archons
chapters.description: Seven Works (T32): raising First Man from contest, crucifying the Living Soul in every body, crucifying the substances of death, establishing ships of light, giving the Five Sons to bear the Girdle, depositing storehouses and watch-places, lifting the cosmos at the consummation. Five Structures (T33): disc on Omophoros, Pillar through midst, molding of Gehennas, pillars in great sea, four walls around strongholds.

chapters.title: The Builder's Other Works and the Ambassador's Four Works
chapters.description: The Great Builder's enumerated works upon the bound archons: heavens and ships, wheels, gates, separation of day/night, fall of abortions, institution of metensomatosis, encircling Zone (T34). The Ambassador's four simultaneous works when his image is revealed (T35): icon manifested in glory, gates of firmaments opened/shut, super-eminent light, indwelling perfection in the elect.

chapters.title: The Mirror-Wheel and the Three Nested Zones
chapters.description: The cosmic Wheel/prochos before the Gate of King of Honor (T36) — twelve seals within, five Men of Radiance as middle seal filling the Zone, holding all bound archons transparent to judicial truth. The Three Zones (T37) nested concentrically: innermost five powers of Darkness, middle Five Sons of First Man fettering the enmity, outermost firmament where King of Honor presides.

chapters.title: The Cosmic Body and the Five Watch-Stations
chapters.description: Error established the cosmos in the likeness of a man — head as firmaments, navel as zodiac-sphere, skin as fire-wall, organs as natural creatures. Within this captive body the Lord stationed five divine guardians corresponding to the five intellectual faculties: Pherokatochos (mind), King of Honor (thought), Adamas of Light (teaching), King of Glory (counsel), Omophoros (reflection).

chapters.title: Adam from the Watchers' Bones and the Soul in Twelve Members
chapters.description: The fallen Watchers bound by four angels; the abortions descending in Adamas's watch and begetting Adam and Eve from the residue of fallen heavenly intelligences (T39). Sin builds the body from five worlds of darkness, binding the soul's five faculties in five somatic substrates (bone, sinew, vein, flesh, skin); the Mind of Light reverses the binding and seats five virtues in the New Man (T40).

chapters.title: The Three Days of Life and the Two Deaths
chapters.description: The complete arc of redemption laid out as three Great Days (descent-and-mingling, intermediate reign in the new aeon, final unveiling of the Father in eternal conjunction) set against two Deaths (temporal death of light-mingled-in-darkness, eternal second death of those severed from the Holy Spirit).

chapters.title: The Three Eternal Works and the Three Plagues Against the Enemy
chapters.description: Three permanent works fashioned in the Light at the consummation (T42): new luminous land, binding of darkness's fire, sealing of sinners in the bolos. Three plagues across the three cosmic ages by which Divine Truth defeats the proprium (T43): cosmogonic binding in the Living Principle, Great Fire of refinement, eschatological splitting of male into bolos and female into tomb.

chapters.title: The Three Dwellings Stripped from the Archons
chapters.description: Three dwellings of water, darkness, fire poured out from the archons by the Living Spirit (T44) — wise physician with three medicines, Youth in womb wearing seven garments, twelve great works of cosmic economy. The Father pouring the three Mighty Ones down to earth in stages so the same elements still trapped within can be drawn upward to meet their kindred (T45).

chapters.title: The Living Spirit's Purification and the Pre-Fashioned Containments
chapters.description: Living Spirit's three formative acts (T46): handing purification to King of Honor's wheels, casting down dragon-Error, fashioning the zodiacal sphere as winnower/peg/all-receiver. Seven 'beforehand' clauses (T47) showing pre-shaped containments for every eruption of evil — fossae, sea-wall, Adamas's foothold, abyss, Watchers' prison.

chapters.title: The Lord's Foresight in Every Age
chapters.description: The 'beforehand' pattern extended: every separating operation is prepared before its crisis. Third Ambassador called before night/day separation; ships of light adorned before lift through Zone; Judge throned before Sin reigns; Christ appointed before Error manifests; stars-and-spheres fitted before generations; Great Builder summoned before new Aeon.

chapters.title: The Star-Wheel and the Three Summonses of Influx
chapters.description: Four ordered receptacles into which the captured archonic host was distributed: firmaments above, eight earths below, encampments around, and the star-sphere — the binding-engine of cosmic purification (T49). Three Wells/summonses by which influx descends and Living Soul ascends — through powers/corpses, through trees, through the five worlds of flesh (T50).

chapters.title: The Wheel That Turns Without Cleaving the Heavens
chapters.description: The cyclic Wheel turns within the heavens stretched from the winds to the earth without cleaving them or being mingled with them — because the heavens are pneumatic. Like a ship parting lions and a bird leaving no path, regenerative motion passes through discrete degrees without disturbing them.

chapters.title: Gods, Rich-Men, Angels — Three Discrete Degrees of Emanation
chapters.description: Three names of divine beings correspond to three discrete degrees of emanation: gods summoned directly by Father (celestial/Greatness), rich-men called by gods (spiritual/Beloved of Lights), angels called by rich-men (natural/Ambassador). The chain of influx by successive callings.

chapters.title: The Five Garments of the First Man and the Light Extracted from Hyle
chapters.description: The First Man's five elemental garments engaging the Enemy: Living Fire wounded, four further garments (wind, water, light, air) sharing the wound and recomposing into the garment of life-light (T53). The cosmos as storehouses built from captured darkness, now emptied of captive light, reducing Hyle to a corpse-body, the 'Death of the Midst' (T54).

chapters.title: The Two Essences and the Molding of Adam and Eve
chapters.description: From the original duality, the Living Spirit and Mother of Life raise up the firmaments as an architect builds a palace, shaping mingled archonic substance into vessels of glory (T55). The archons, seeing the Ambassador's revealed icon, mold Adam and Eve as a true seal pressed into corrupt substance — the somatic Adam as counterfeit likeness carrying the divine imprint (T56).

chapters.title: The Body as City of Sense-Storehouses
chapters.description: The body as encampment with gates: each sense an enthumesis with its own storehouses (eye, ear, smell, taste, touch); the heart as king/cellarer over all five enthumeses; archon-watchmen at every gate; the Mind of Light arriving to humble the gate-archons and seize the keys.

chapters.title: Why the First Generations Lived Long
chapters.description: Five lords of the sphere — year, month, day, hour, moment — successively governing five descending generations. Adam was begotten under the lord of the year (celestial fullness); we are begotten under the lord of the moment (bare ultimate). The descent of human life through the discrete degrees from celestial to sensual.

chapters.title: The Three Griefs and the Four Weepings
chapters.description: Three powers grieving over the captive Living Soul (T59): Mother of Life for her children mingled in Darkness; First Man for his Five Sons in danger; a third grieving power. Four weepings of the Five Sons / garments of First Man (T60): three at descent into mingling, a fourth at the consummation when souls bound to Darkness are sealed away from rest forever.

chapters.title: Hidden Members and the Revealing Tongue
chapters.description: The body's hidden interior members ↔ the Father hidden in his kingship; the two outwardly-set eyes ↔ the two ships of light (sun and moon) as manifest Radiances; the tongue that speaks from within ↔ Jesus the Radiance sent forth from the Greatness as the revealing member who proclaims the soul's wound and healing.

chapters.title: The First Man Clothed in the Elements for War
chapters.description: Divine Truth clothes itself in the elements, hands its 'lions-garment' (the dominion-zeal of the Living Soul) to the archons of death; they swallow it and the swallowed light becomes a hidden river of Judgment burning them from within. The visible judgment on earth is only the smallest branch of the vast inward judgment.

chapters.title: The Three Rocks of Glory and the Cosmic Origin of Love and Hate
chapters.description: Three Rocks (T63) — confirmed truths in ultimates set by the Greatness in the outer worlds: Pillar of Glory bearing upward, new Land of Light pressed upon Land of Darkness, great Thought (Jesus the Radiance) awakening. Love defined as the bond of the Greatness, Hatred as the first death gushing from Land of Darkness, descending through envy → devil → wicked one (T64).

chapters.title: The Three Things Shown to Adam
chapters.description: Three great works altered in Adam: the icon of the Exalted One sealed upon him; his molding after the firstborn of heaven and the Five Sons; the seal of the entire cosmos arranged in him as houses of zodiac, stars, days. Seven reasons why he was so fashioned, ending in his dignity as head and king of all creatures.

chapters.title: The Sun and Moon as Visible Mysteries
chapters.description: The sun fashioned as likeness of the First Greatness (T66), with seven goods of light vs seven wickednesses of night. The sun's daily course as two great mysteries (T67): rising as primal shining of First Man, setting as final extraction of Last Andrias. Ambassador in the sun (T68): dawn rehearses the original descent driving Sons of Darkness from storehouses; dusk rehearses the consummation gathering elect into the Pleroma.

chapters.title: The Five Works of Fire
chapters.description: Fire (love/will) performs five complete works: releases/burns wood, separates four likenesses (fire/light/smoke/vapor), gives taste and savor, shapes vessels through artisans, manifests light for sight. The five-fold operation of love at the natural-rational interface.

chapters.title: The Twelve Zodia Bound in the Sphere
chapters.description: Twelve zodia molded out of Five Worlds of Darkness, two per world; five wandering stars distributed accordingly with two Anabibazons as makers of evil. The Great Artisan binds them all in the sphere. Sun and Moon are reckoned among them only by economy, not belonging to the dark dominion. Twelve-fold articulation built upon five-fold worlds.

chapters.title: The Cosmos as Body of Man (Extended)
chapters.description: The whole cosmos exists as the likeness of the body of a man, with firmaments as head, ten firmaments to heart, sphere-wheel as heart, and so on down to the soles of feet. Five watches (Pherokatochos, King of Honor, Adamas, King of Glory, Omophoros) rule the cosmic drama of regeneration; 840 myriads of archons in 210 myriads of houses lodge in the body. Extended parallel to T38.

chapters.title: The Gathering-Inward and the Many Names of the One Garment
chapters.description: The vertical ladder of conjunction (T72): elements gather to elements of higher kindred → Tamr → Answer → Call → chosen Mind/Noeric → Pillar of Glory → First Man → Ambassador → aeons of the Greatness. All the great-garment names — Jesus, pearl-ornaments, icons, Cross of Light, Counsel of Life — designate one reality: the Living Soul dispersed in the natural (T73).

chapters.title: The Envy of Hyle and the Eight Places of the Living Fire
chapters.description: Hyle's envy as the primal nature in Worlds of Darkness, working through four counterfeitings (T74): of First Man's garment, of Ambassador's icon (stamped into flesh as Adam), of Adam (Eve begotten by stolen power), of Christ. The Living Fire (divine love) at eight places (T75): Land of Light below, Father, First Man, sun, moon, the Living one as vehicle of Call/Hearing, etc.

chapters.title: The Apostle's Letter of Peace
chapters.description: The Apostle's salutation as the ultimate-form of cosmic letters between the Living Spirit and the molded man: the Calling sent down, the answering Hearing rising up bearing the record of all wars and contests, the Mind of Light from Christ as apostolic letter, every event in the soul's struggle inscribed.

chapters.title: The Four Kingdoms and the Five Works of Sin
chapters.description: Four great kingdoms in the world (T77) — Babylon-Persia, Rome, Aksum, Sileus — as the complete fourfold ordering of natural dominion, none exalted exceedingly above the others. Four/Five great works of Sin (T78): appetite, fornication, wealth/boasting, war/tyranny — set against the single saving work of the Apostle (separation of Light from Darkness).

chapters.title: The Daily Purification and the Two Faces of Heaven
chapters.description: Regeneration as continuous daily reception of Divine Truth as nourishment by which mingled Darkness (the archonic host within) is purified, cleansed, filtered, washed forth (T79). The single heavenly prosopon bearing two faces (T80): face of agape (beauty with longing) and face of love-of-strife — the latter habitually refined out by the powers of heaven on account of the Living Soul mingled in them.

chapters.title: The Pearl in the Sea
chapters.description: The body considered as oyster in the sea: heavenly drops descending to mingle with sweet waters and form the pearl. The soul refined into the New Man where heavenly Divine Truth meets the receptive natural. Wells of above vs wells of below; food and water received in stillness or disturbance. The body-cosmos-pearl correspondence at the natural ultimates.

chapters.title: The Soul's Ascent to the Luminaries and the Eight Paths
chapters.description: The soul under trial finds no resting-gate among the powers of heaven and earth (her defilers) but only in the sun and moon (T82) — Divine Truth in its illuminating manifestation and receptive reflection. Ten ways drawn from the Zone (T83): four chosen ascending to life through the ships, others reckoned to Error pouring into Gehenna through lawlessness, killing, the wounding word, blasphemy.

chapters.title: The Elements Bound to the Cross of Light
chapters.description: The four elements as Living Soul mingled with darkness, bound to the Cross of Light in the body, casting off a graded cascade of defiled garments — bond, wrath, desire, bitterness, heat, flesh, gloom, severity, summed as twelve strippings. Two endings: ascent to first rest, or metensomatosis under sentence.

chapters.title: The Three Causes of Storm and the Soul as Second Field
chapters.description: Clouds rise from below to the air of the midst against the Virgin of Light (T85); three modes of cosmic purification through clouds from fire (corrupt love), from water (mingled truth), from wind (disordered perception); archons stripped, light raised in first icon, residue cast to seven fossae outside the great sea. The purified Living Soul as second ploughed-field tilled by the two great luminaries (T86).

chapters.title: The Three Begettings of the Flesh
chapters.description: Three modes of begetting flesh: by sexual joining, by fall of abortions, by self-molding from the ground. Trees with enthumesis seated in root, branch, or seed. The virgin (parthenos) and continent (enkratēs) defined at four ascending registers: untouched Light, mingled-and-returned Light, Mind of Light bearing icons, regenerate man stripped of Sin.

chapters.title: The Virgin and the Twelve Openings of the Dragon
chapters.description: Body as twelve-gated dragon: seven sense-organs of head (eyes, ears, nostrils, mouth) + five caves of body below (throat, breath, etc.). The Virgin/Continent defined as the soul that recognizes the dragon (= enthumesis of the body / Hyle), fights, and prevails over her. Twelve-fold articulation = seven + five.

chapters.title: The Reflected Face — Call and Hearing in Water
chapters.description: Why the man bending over water sees his face inverted: the mystery of the Call descending from above (head turned downward as accommodation into Darkness) and the Answer rising from below (face righted as Hearing lifted to the First Man). The shadow on the earth as sign that the body has been raised up out of the Deep.

chapters.title: The Five Offspring of the Body's Food
chapters.description: Every nourishment received by the body divides into five offspring: breath rising through mind, voice and speech, discharge through power and shame, seed begotten through pleasure of desire, somatic child molded in flesh. The unregenerate man perceives only the last; four offspring not made manifest to him.

chapters.title: The Two Sorrows of the Luminaries
chapters.description: Even the sun and moon — most stable, casting no shadow — bear grief upon their heart: they see the King of Darkness enthroned as counterfeit king-face (first corruption), and they see the Living Soul drawn taut, eaten, transferred body to body (second corruption, the Cross of Light). Their joy will be permanent at the consummation when the soul is redeemed and the enemy bound.

chapters.title: The Word as Five-Minted Coin and the Buds in the Elements
chapters.description: The word born inwardly is shaped by five organs of the mouth into audible likeness; like a coin minted by five artisans before passing into commerce (T92). The new grain molded and adorned in the five elements through cooperation of heat (love) and cold (form-holding truth); contrasted with Hyle's energeia inundating the elements with shadow and destroying fruits (T93).

chapters.title: The Five Garments and the Pentecost of the Soul
chapters.description: Recapitulation: First Man's five garments (Five Sons / elements as Living Soul) each holding five inner powers; Call descending and Answer rising; twenty characters in twenty members; fifty holy days of fasting (Pentecost) doubled to one hundred as liturgical participation in Call-and-Answer until the coming of Jesus the Radiance.

chapters.title: The Hidden Things in the Eye and the Senses
chapters.description: Two parallel fragmentary teachings on the senses as cosmic battlefield: 200,000 divine seals against 200,000 archons of darkness (T95) sorted daily by election/purification/inward gathering versus expulsion into Error. The eye as microcosm with four visible types and a hidden fifth, doubled into outer/inner fourfolds, with fire/darkness concealed and Living Air discriminating (T96).

chapters.title: The Five-fold Cosmos and the Light Through the Gates
chapters.description: The cosmos held in being only by its complete five-fold structure (T97), sustained by the bearing-power (Omophoros) and manifest substance (Lord's Wisdom); five great matters revealed by the Apostle to the elect. Light comes forth through gates open firmament by firmament across the four climes, drawing captive light upward through the threefold strongholds (T98).

chapters.title: The Three Icons in the Righteous Man
chapters.description: Three discrete degrees of the regenerate human: pneumatic icon (the New Man, seat of the Mind of Light), psychic icon (mediating soul bound to flesh, the Old Man), somatic icon (body containing them). The daily soul-cycle of descent through eating and ascent through purification; the Virgin of Light as queen and robe of the New Man, called 'the hour of life,' first and last.

chapters.title: The Threefold Prayer and the Threefold Sending
chapters.description: The Mother of Life intercedes for the First Man fallen into mingling; the Father answers by sending the Living Spirit who raises the First Man and structures the cosmos; the Five intercede again; the Third Ambassador chooses out the Living Soul; Jesus the Radiance completes the purpose-of-heart of the elements. Threefold prayer met by threefold sending unto eternity.

chapters.title: Discrete Degrees in the Body and Mystical Sight
chapters.description: Why pruning hair and nails causes no pain but cutting members does: discrete degrees within the body (T101). Pain marks where the Living Soul is held; outer growths from impurities of food are not bearers. Mystical seeing in sickness when soul is briefly loosed from body (T102) — typology of seers by duration and direction (Deep or Light), with seven and three categories.

chapters.title: The Two Substances and the Yes-Amen as Call and Hearing
chapters.description: Closing summary of the foundational dualism: two substances exist from the beginning — Light and Darkness, beautiful and bitter, life and death — and the whole spiritual labor consists in separating the beautiful from the Darkness (T103). The cosmic scaffolding (pillars, Omophoros, Five Sons as food of the man) revealed as held in being by the Calling, and the liturgical Yes and Amen identified as Call and Hearing — the two great cosmic operations of redemption (T104). The corpus closes by returning to its opening dualism and naming the consummating principle of conjunction.

teachings.title: The Mingling, the Molding of Adam, and the Eyes Opened in the Cosmos
teachings.description: Opening fragment: cosmic clash → mingling → Hyle's bringing-forth → molding of Adam in the Deep → eyes opened. Establishes the foundational scene of the proprium's first formation. Heavily damaged but structurally meaningful as the corpus opener.

teachings.title: The Two Trees and the Five Members
teachings.description: Life and Death as corresponding five-membered organisms with the same faculties (reflection, counsel, teaching, thought, mind) bearing Jesus as fruit upward in the Beautiful Tree and inverting downward into the bolos in the Bitter Tree. Establishes five-fold constitution as basic architecture.

teachings.title: Goodness, Wisdom, and Power at Three Discrete Degrees
teachings.description: The triad of Eudaimonia, Sophia, Power at three discrete degrees: Father → cosmos of aeons → elements. At the elemental register Power is the Five Sons of First Man bearing up the All. Establishes three-fold descent governing macro-degrees of the corpus.

teachings.title: The Four Great Days and Their Twelve Hours
teachings.description: Four great Days emanating from each other (Father, Ambassador, Pillar, Radiance) each with twelve-hour fullness, mirrored by Four Nights with twelve shadows. The Pillar's twelve = Five Sons of First Man + Five Sons of Living Spirit + Call/Hearing.

teachings.title: The Four Faces of Light Set Against Four of Darkness
teachings.description: Four operative Faces of Light (First Man, Ambassador, Jesus, Great Counsel) sent forth from the Greatness with their tree, stature, ship; matched by four Counterparts of Darkness (King of Darkness, evil counsel, desire, law of Sin and Death).

teachings.title: The Anatomy of the Five Worlds of Darkness
teachings.description: Complete five-fold inverted anatomy of the proprium: five worlds with five archons, five spirits, five bodies, five tastes, five trees; the King of Darkness as composite beast-body of gold. The negative mirror of the Five Storehouses.

teachings.title: The Five Fathers as Discrete Degrees of Accommodation
teachings.description: Chain of Five Fathers — Father of Greatness → Third Ambassador → Jesus the Radiance → Mind of Light → Form of Light — each producing a triad. The Form of Light meets the soul leaving the body and clothes it with garments of light.

teachings.title: The Ten Chariots of Jesus the Son
teachings.description: Jesus the Son's descent through ten vehicles: vessel of light, chariot of First Man, Pillar of Glory, Call, Answer, and the five living elements (Air, Wind, Light, Water, Fire). Five structural vehicles + five living elements.

teachings.title: The Five Mysteries by Which the First Man Returned
teachings.description: Five everyday gestures (peace, salutation, kiss, right hand, chirotonia) as the five mysteries by which the First Man went out, was raised home, and by which every soul is welcomed at death. Same five enacted on three planes.

teachings.title: The Spiritual Man as Microcosm of the Twelve Aeons
teachings.description: The Twelve Great Aeons reproduced as members in the regenerate man: five faculties + Calling/Hearing = seven, indwelt by Living Spirit and centered on the Ambassador. Spiritual Man as microcosm of the heavens.

teachings.title: The Origin of Every Good
teachings.description: Litany of 'origin' statements tracing every class of good (gifts, blessings, counsels, honors, warriors, builders, releasers, wisdoms, awakenings) back to specific divine sources from Father of Lights down to Mind of Light.

teachings.title: The Five Sayings That Found the Mind of Light
teachings.description: Five confessional sayings as the doctrinal ground supporting the Mind of Light: unnameable Father, Ambassador/Father of Life, living law, Mother's redemptive gift, all as one living body. The five seals of the regenerate rational.

teachings.title: The Five Drawers-Upward as Architecture of Resurrection
teachings.description: Five Sons of the Awakener / drawers-upward as discrete operations answering to the five faculties: foremost, second, First Father, Mind of Light, last gatherer. The complete ladder by which the dead soul is lifted through every degree to the Father.

teachings.title: The Twelve Dignities of the Cosmos of Death
teachings.description: The cosmos of death built from Death's five pourings: five worlds of flesh, twelve spirits of error from the twelve zodiac-signs, all subdued by the First Man. The inverted twelve-fold structure that mirrors the heavens.

teachings.title: The Twelve Greatnesses Arranged as Five — Descent Reaching Adam
teachings.description: Cosmology of redemption as five-fold descent: hidden Father → Mother of Life with First Man → Living Spirit → Third Ambassador → Jesus the Radiance, reaching down to Adam and Eve's flesh and home in the Last Andrias. Most direct evidence for 5×something articulation.

teachings.title: The Three Cosmic Ages of Redemption
teachings.description: Three discrete ages — descent of First Man (greatest), building of cosmos by Living Spirit and Mother (least), revealing by Third Ambassador to Panaretos's ascent (middle). The macro-timeline of redemption in three-fold fullness.

teachings.title: The Four Wars Between Sons of Light and Sons of Darkness
teachings.description: Four discrete redemptive operations: First Man's descent (planting), Living Spirit's structuring (binding), Third Ambassador's revealing (icon), Jesus the Radiance's glorifying (stripping/establishing). Each war handles self-love at a distinct degree.

teachings.title: The Four (Five) Salvations as Discrete Saving Operations
teachings.description: Five discrete savings (despite title): First Man, Living Spirit, Third Ambassador, Jesus the Radiance, Great Counsel. Saving as discrete degrees rather than single act. Direct evidence of five-fold articulation within four-fold framing.

teachings.title: Greatness as the Bearing Realm of Every Father-Source
teachings.description: Greatness defined as the Great Land — the bearing substance of Light established in fullness. The Father is the first who stands fast within it. Father-Greatness pattern repeats at five registers: Father, Ambassador, Radiance, Pillar, five holy gods.

teachings.title: The First Father in His Five Members and Twelve Wisdoms
teachings.description: The Father established in his Five Members of light (the five intellectual faculties as inmost articulation of the Divine), with twelve members of light = twelve Wisdoms. Five attributes (Light, Fragrance, Voice, ...) gush forth from him into the aeons.

teachings.title: The Land of Light in Its Perfect Order
teachings.description: The Land of Light as celestial state — living ambrosia and living drug, beautiful members, summoned from the Father, dwelling established in him; trees and plants gushing forth, no admixture of falsehood, death, or mingling.

teachings.title: Eternity and the Stillness of the Father
teachings.description: The unchanging existence of Light from the beginning: the Father standing before and unto eternity; the Land of Light as eternal stillness contrasted with the Land of Death whose end is fixed within itself; the inmost celestial unrevealable in ultimates.

teachings.title: Hyle's Self-Begetting from the Enthumesis of Death
teachings.description: Hyle alone in her own land molding and begetting from herself five corrupt elements (smoke, fire, wind, water, darkness) producing trees, fruits, and worlds without conjunction — the corrupt counterpart of the Mother of Life.

teachings.title: Cosmic Time, Building, and Dissolution
teachings.description: The unmeasurable Father set against countable measures of cosmic time: silver, sand, wreaths, rivers, all bounded; Hyle's slow generation through five elements; the four-fold sequence ending in the 1468-year fire of consummation.

teachings.title: The Father's Emanations from His Five Members
teachings.description: Each great emanation issues from one of the Father's five faculties: Beloved of Lights from mind, Mother of Life from thought, Beloved from teaching, Virgin of Light from counsel, fifth from reflection. Most direct expression of five-fold radial constitution at the divine source.

teachings.title: Three Likenesses of the One Redemption
teachings.description: Three parables answering 'to what are these likened?': First Man as famous man recovering scattered sons (descent); Living Spirit as wise craftsman in furnace-ship (structuring/rescue); Third Ambassador as great man recovering captives in foreign country (awakening).

teachings.title: The Five Forms in the King of Darkness
teachings.description: King of Darkness as inverted Grand Man with five bestial members from the Five Worlds: lion-head, eagle-wings, demon-feet, dark-belly, fish-loins. Body iron/bronze cannot pierce; life is bile of wrath.

teachings.title: The Twelve Judges Sent from the Greatness
teachings.description: Twelve great judges proceeding from one Father, each performing a distinct discrimination: First Man humbled, Living Spirit ascending, Mother of Life raising, King of Honor in seventh firmament, Ambassador, Radiance, judge in air, Last Andrias.

teachings.title: The Twelve Thrones of Glory in Two Registers
teachings.description: Nine outer thrones in the aeons of Greatness mirrored by nine inner thrones in the cosmos (sun-ship, moon-ship, seventh firmament, air, lowest), ending at the Judge of Truth in the air with three ways: death, life, agreement.

teachings.title: The Three Garments of the Living Spirit
teachings.description: The Living Spirit clothes himself in three garments — wind, fire, water (perception, will, natural truth) — to subject the works of darkness above and below; then strips and scatters their contents for purification and conveys the refined remainder upward.

teachings.title: The Call's Descent Through the Members of the Soul
teachings.description: First Man as head with members of the Living Soul hung upon him; Pillar of Glory beneath, Father above clothed in Virgin of Light. The five faculties sent forth after the Call to track and gather the dispersed Living Soul into the icon of the Father.

teachings.title: The Seven Works of the Living Spirit
teachings.description: Seven works: raising First Man as pearl from sea; crucifying the Living Soul in every body; crucifying substances of death; establishing ships of light; giving Five Sons to bear the Girdle; depositing storehouses and watch-places; lifting the cosmos at consummation.

teachings.title: The Five Structures Built into the Bound Archons
teachings.description: Five great structures established through the channels of conquered archons: disc on Omophoros, Pillar through midst, molding of Gehennas, pillars in great sea (seventh kind), four walls around strongholds.

teachings.title: The Great Builder's Other Works upon the Bound Archons
teachings.description: Numbered enumeration of Builder's constructive works upon bound archons: building anew, ships filling heavens, wheels sending forth life, gates inward toward Error, separation of night/day, fall of abortions, institution of metensomatosis, encircling Zone.

teachings.title: The Four Works of the Ambassador's Revealing
teachings.description: Four simultaneous works when the Ambassador's image is revealed: icon manifested in glory, gates of firmaments opened/shut, super-eminent chosen-out light, indwelling perfection in the elect as hidden chamber against the worlds of enmity.

teachings.title: The Mirror-Wheel Before the King of Honor
teachings.description: Cosmic Wheel/prochos before the Gate of King of Honor — twelve seals, with five Men of Radiance as middle seal filling the Zone, holding all bound archons transparent to judicial truth. Cyclic mechanism of purification in ultimates.

teachings.title: The Three Nested Zones of the Cosmos
teachings.description: Three concentric Zones built by Living Spirit: innermost five powers of Darkness (males/females), middle Five Sons of First Man fettering the enmity, outermost firmament-Zone where the great King of Honor presides. Evil bound within good bound within divine governance.

teachings.title: The Cosmos as Captive Body and the Five Watch-Stations
teachings.description: Error established the cosmos in the likeness of a man (head/firmaments, navel/zodiac, skin/fire-wall). Within this captive body the Lord stationed five guardians corresponding to the five faculties: Pherokatochos (mind), King of Honor (thought), Adamas (teaching), King of Glory (counsel), Omophoros (reflection).

teachings.title: Adam Formed from the Bones of the Watchers' Children
teachings.description: Fallen Watchers bound by four angels in eternal bond; abortions descending in Adamas's watch and begetting Adam and Eve from the residue. Sin rooted in the body until the Mind of Light is rooted there as a tree in its place.

teachings.title: The Soul's Twelvefold Binding and Release in the Body
teachings.description: Sin builds body from five Worlds of Darkness, binds soul's five faculties in five somatic substrates (mind/bone, thought/sinew, teaching/vein, counsel/flesh, reflection/skin); Mind of Light reverses, places five virtues in the New Man — twelvefold articulation of the regenerate.

teachings.title: The Three Days of Life and the Two Deaths
teachings.description: Whole arc of redemption as three Great Days (descent-and-mingling, intermediate reign, final unveiling of Father) set against two Deaths (temporal mingling ending in great fire; eternal severance from Light, living Air, Living Soul, bound in three places of bolos and tomb).

teachings.title: The Three Eternal Works at the Consummation
teachings.description: Three permanent works fashioned in the Light: new luminous land, binding of darkness's fire, sealing of sinners in the last bolos with the great guard between forever. No beginning and no end of willing to be — permanence of consummated states.

teachings.title: The Three Plagues Against the Enemy
teachings.description: Three plagues across three cosmic ages: cosmogonic binding of King of Darkness in the Living Principle, Great Fire of present age releasing/separating/gathering hidden icons, eschatological splitting (male into bolos, female into tomb).

teachings.title: The Three Dwellings Stripped from the Archons
teachings.description: Living Spirit as wise physician applying three medicines to extract three modes of falsity (water/darkness/fire) from natural heavens; clothing himself in pure correspondents (wind/water/fire); Youth in womb wearing seven garments; twelve great works of cosmic economy.

teachings.title: The Three Mighty Ones Poured to Earth and Recovered
teachings.description: Father pours three strongholds (Water, Darkness, Fire) down from heaven onto the earth in stages so the same elements still trapped in the natural can be drawn upward to meet their kindred. Salty sea, mountain of darkness, fire-mountains as visible deposits.

teachings.title: The Living Spirit's Ascent and the Three Works of the Sphere
teachings.description: After ordering the worlds, Living Spirit ascends and signals King of Honor to turn the wheels — casting the Error/dragon down from star-wheel into the sea where Hyle's enthumesis fashions it into the zodiacal sphere performing three works: winnowing, restraining (Holder), gathering.

teachings.title: The Pre-Fashioned Containments — Beforehand Pattern
teachings.description: Seven 'beforehand' clauses showing pre-shaped containments for every eruption of evil: three fossae for places of deceit, wall in great sea, Adamas's foothold, abyss for archonic host, prison for Watchers, twelve cities for Giants — providence anticipating each crisis.

teachings.title: The Lord's Foresight in Every Separating Operation
teachings.description: Beforehand pattern extended: Third Ambassador called before night/day separation; ships of light adorned before lift; Judge throned before Sin reigns; Christ appointed before Error manifests; stars-and-spheres fitted before generations; releasers given sign before cosmos released; Great Builder summoned before new Aeon.

teachings.title: The Star-Wheel as Binding-Engine
teachings.description: Four ordered receptacles for captured archonic host: ten firmaments above, eight earths below, encampments around, sphere of stars (zodiac) — third-kind powers hung facing one another, fixed in turning Wheel, neither absorbed by heaven nor crushed into earth.

teachings.title: The Three Wells / Summonses of Influx
teachings.description: Three discrete channels by which influx descends and the Living Soul ascends — first through powers/corpses, second through trees, third through five worlds of flesh; each rooted differently between heaven and earth.

teachings.title: The Wheel That Turns Without Cleaving the Heavens
teachings.description: Wheel turns within heavens stretched from winds to earth without cleaving them, because heavens are pneumatic. Like ship parting lions and bird leaving no path, regenerative cyclic motion passes through discrete degrees without disturbing them.

teachings.title: Gods, Rich-Men, Angels — Three Discrete Degrees
teachings.description: Three names of divine beings = three degrees of emanation: gods called by Father (celestial/Greatness), rich-men called by gods (spiritual/Beloved of Lights), angels called by rich-men (natural/Ambassador). Chain of influx by successive callings.

teachings.title: The Five Garments of the First Man and the Two Garments of the Departing Soul
teachings.description: First Man's five elemental garments engaging the Enemy: Living Fire wounded; four further garments (wind/water/light/air) sharing the wound and recomposing into garment of life-light. Two kingdoms each 'alone' in its single principle determines a soul's departure.

teachings.title: The Light Extracted from Hyle's Storehouses
teachings.description: Living Spirit's archons capture darkness's elements; cosmos built as storehouses; once captive light is drawn out, Hyle is reduced to a corpse-body, the 'Death of the Midst'. Lions seizing fish/birds while leaving plants.

teachings.title: The Two Essences and the Firmaments as Palace
teachings.description: From original duality, Living Spirit and Mother of Life raise the firmaments as architect builds palace, shaping mingled archonic substance into vessels of glory; ten firmaments and prochos of stars; the great king's coming raises the wise and casts Error to the Deep.

teachings.title: The Molding of Adam and Eve After the Stolen Icon
teachings.description: Archons see Ambassador's revealed image, desire it, and mold Adam and Eve as a true seal pressed into corrupt substance. The somatic Adam as counterfeit likeness carrying divine imprint; sent for the sake of the Son crucified in the All.

teachings.title: The Body as City of Sense-Storehouses
teachings.description: Body as encampment with gates, towers, watch-stations: each sense an enthumesis with its storehouses; heart as king/cellarer over five enthumeses; archon-watchmen at gates; Mind of Light arriving to humble gate-archons and seize the keys.

teachings.title: Why the First Generations Lived Long — Five Lords of the Sphere
teachings.description: Five lords of the sphere — year, month, day, hour, moment — successively governing five descending generations. Adam under year (celestial), we under moment (bare ultimate). The descent of human life through discrete degrees.

teachings.title: The Three Griefs of the Mother of Life
teachings.description: Three powers grieving for the captive Living Soul: Mother of Life for her children mingled in Darkness; First Man for his Five Sons in danger from Vessel of Light; a third grieving power. Compassion structurally present at every level of the Divine.

teachings.title: The Four Weepings of the First Man's Garments
teachings.description: Five Sons / garments of First Man weep three times at descent (foreknowing the Darkness, then silent under Necessity); a fourth, unending weeping at consummation when souls 'prepared for Error' are separated from the Last Andrias and bound with the Darkness they loved.

teachings.title: Hidden Members and the Revealing Tongue
teachings.description: Body's hidden interior ↔ Father hidden in his kingship; two outwardly-set eyes ↔ two ships of light (sun and moon) as manifest Radiances; tongue speaking from within ↔ Jesus the Radiance sent forth from the Greatness as revealing member proclaiming the soul's wound and healing.

teachings.title: The First Man Clothed in the Elements for War
teachings.description: Divine Truth clothes itself in elements; hands 'lions-garment' to archons of death; they swallow it; swallowed light becomes hidden river of Judgment burning them within. Visible judgment on earth is smallest branch of vast inward judgment.

teachings.title: The Three Rocks of Glory
teachings.description: Three confirmed truths in ultimates set in outer worlds: Pillar of Glory / Perfect Man (bearing-up), new Land of Light upon Land of Darkness (subduing), great Thought / Jesus the Radiance (awakening). Threefold foundation of redemptive economy.

teachings.title: Love as the Bond of the Greatness; Hatred as the First Death
