teachings.description: Love defined as the conjoining principle by which the Father holds the heavens as one Divine Human body; Hatred as first death gushing from Land of Darkness, descending through envy → devil → wicked one. Two great affections that organize heaven and hell.

teachings.title: The Three Things Shown to Adam and Seven Reasons
teachings.description: Three great works in Adam: icon of the Exalted One sealed upon him; molding after firstborn of heaven and Five Sons; seal of cosmos arranged as houses of zodiac/stars/days. Seven reasons culminating in his dignity as head and king of all creatures.

teachings.title: The Sun as Likeness of the First Greatness
teachings.description: Sun fashioned as likeness of the First Greatness — gate of Life and stronghold of Peace; seven goods of light against seven wickednesses of night. The luminary as visible icon of the Father in the cosmos.

teachings.title: Sun and Night as Visible Mysteries
teachings.description: Sun's daily course as two great mysteries: rising as primal shining of First Man driving Sons of Darkness from storehouses; setting as final extraction of Last Andrias gathering elect into Pleroma. Five works of sun: light, beauty, peace, releasing Living Soul, power-and-taste in Cross of Light.

teachings.title: The Ambassador in the Sun
teachings.description: Sun rising and setting as daily rehearsal of the Third Ambassador's two mysteries: dawn rehearses original descent driving sons of Darkness from storehouses and breaking body of their Five Sons; dusk rehearses consummation gathering elect into mansions while unredeemed shut into sunless night.

teachings.title: The Five Works of Fire
teachings.description: Fire (love/will) performs five complete works: releases/burns wood (loosens receptive natural), separates four likenesses (fire/light/smoke/vapor), gives taste and savor, shapes vessels through artisans, manifests light for sight. Five-fold operation of love.

teachings.title: The Twelve Zodia Bound in the Sphere
teachings.description: Twelve zodia molded from Five Worlds of Darkness (two per world); five wandering stars distributed accordingly; two Anabibazons as makers of evil. Great Artisan binds them all in the sphere; Sun and Moon traverse them by economy only, not belonging to dark dominion.

teachings.title: The Cosmos as Body of Man (Extended)
teachings.description: Whole cosmos exists as likeness of body of man — head/firmaments, heart/sphere, soles/great earth. Five watches (Pherokatochos, King of Honor, Adamas, King of Glory, Omophoros) rule cosmic drama. 840 myriads of archons in 210 myriads of houses lodge in body. Extended parallel to T38.

teachings.title: The Gathering-Inward of the Elements
teachings.description: Vertical ladder of conjunction: each element to its higher kindred → Tamr → Answer → Call → chosen Mind / Noeric → Pillar of Glory → First Man → Ambassador → aeons of the Greatness. The whole column rises as one organism into the inmost.

teachings.title: The Many Names of the One Garment
teachings.description: All great-garment names — Jesus, pearl-ornaments, icons-and-tunics, element of light, Cross of Light, Counsel of Life, afflicted soul — designate one reality: the Living Soul / Divine Truth dispersed in the natural; gathered at consummation into one likeness, one name.

teachings.title: The Envy of Hyle as Primal Nature
teachings.description: Envy as primal nature in Worlds of Darkness, working through four counterfeitings: of First Man's garment (staining); of Ambassador's icon (counterfeited as somatic Adam); of Adam (Eve begotten by stolen power); of Christ with Righteousness and cross.

teachings.title: The Eight Places of the Living Fire
teachings.description: Living Fire (divine love as cosmic will-substance) at eight discrete stations: great Land below outside the All; Father; First Man (weapon); fourth and fifth (sun/moon as ships of light); the Living one as vehicle of Call/Hearing; first woman (regenerate land); cosmic signs.

teachings.title: The Apostle's Letter of Peace
teachings.description: Apostle's salutation as ultimate-form of cosmic letters: Calling sent from Living Spirit to molded man; First Man's ascent as answering letter bearing record of all wars; Mind of Light from Christ as apostolic letter. Every event in soul's struggle inscribed.

teachings.title: The Four Great Kingdoms in the World
teachings.description: Four great kingdoms (Babylon-Persia, Rome, Aksum, Sileus) as complete fourfold ordering of natural dominion; none exalted exceedingly above the others. The ceiling of natural rule, distinguishing by negation the truly exalted dominion of King of Honor and the Father.

teachings.title: The Four (Five) Great Works of Sin
teachings.description: Four great matters by which men kill one another: appetite/eating, fornication, wealth/boasting, war/tyranny — proprium displayed in every direction of natural life; set against the Apostle's single saving work of separating Light from Darkness.

teachings.title: The Daily Purification of the Soul
teachings.description: Regeneration as continuous daily reception of Divine Truth as nourishment by which mingled Darkness (the archonic host within) is purified, cleansed, filtered, washed forth. Steady dietary work of Light separating truth from falsity in the soul.

teachings.title: The Two Faces of the Heavenly Prosopon
teachings.description: Single heavenly prosopon bearing two faces: face of agape (beauty with longing) and face of love-of-strife — the latter habitually refined out by powers of heaven on account of the Living Soul mingled in them. The contrary face being continually purified at the heavenly level.

teachings.title: The Pearl in the Sea — How the Soul-Body Becomes the New Man
teachings.description: Body as oyster in sea: heavenly drops descend mingling with sweet waters to form pearl. Soul refined into New Man where heavenly Divine Truth meets receptive natural. Wells of above vs wells of below; food and water received in stillness or disturbance.

teachings.title: The Two Luminaries as the Only Gate of Rest
teachings.description: Soul under trial finds no resting-gate among powers of heaven and earth (her defilers) but only in sun and moon (Divine Truth in illuminating manifestation and receptive reflection). Through them she passes to country of her kindred; the Land of Light becomes their final receiver.

teachings.title: The Ten Ways from the Zone — Eight Paths to Gehenna
teachings.description: Ten ways drawn from the cosmic Zone: four chosen ascending to life through the ships, others reckoned to Error pouring down to Gehenna through lawlessness, killing, the wounding word against Cross of Light, blasphemy mocking the gods.

teachings.title: The Four Elements Bound to the Cross of Light
teachings.description: Four elements as Living Soul mingled with darkness, bound to Cross of Light in the body, casting off graded cascade of defiled garments — bond, wrath, desire, bitterness, heat, flesh, gloom, severity, summed as twelve strippings. Two endings: ascent or metensomatosis under sentence.

teachings.title: The Cloud and the Three Causes of Storm
teachings.description: Clouds as mediating state where trapped archons of fire/water/wind are lifted to air of the midst, made visible against the icon of the Virgin of Light, struck by angels, captured into tree and flesh, finally stripped, light extracted or residue cast to seven fossae outside great sea.

teachings.title: The Living Soul as Second Field Tilled by the Two Luminaries
teachings.description: Purified Living Soul as second ploughed-field within the entire Zone of upper place; two great luminaries (sun and moon as Divine Truth illuminating and reflecting) doing farmer's work over her, drawing her toward likeness of the Divine Human and upward to the Height.

teachings.title: The Three Begettings of the Flesh
teachings.description: Three modes of begetting flesh (sexual joining, abortions, self-molding from ground); trees with enthumesis seated in root, branch, or seed. Virgin/Continent defined at four ascending registers from celestial untouched Light to regenerate man stripped of Sin.

teachings.title: The Twelve Openings of the Dragon and the Victory That Makes the Virgin
teachings.description: Body as twelve-gated dragon: seven sense-organs of head + five caves of body below. Virgin/Continent defined as soul that recognizes the dragon (= enthumesis of body / Hyle), fights, and prevails. Twelve = seven + five.

teachings.title: The Reflected Face — Call and Hearing in Water
teachings.description: Why man bending over water sees his face inverted: mystery of Call descending (head turned downward as accommodation into Darkness) and Answer rising (face righted as Hearing lifted to First Man). Shadow on earth as sign that body has been raised up out of the Deep.

teachings.title: The Five Offspring of the Body's Food
teachings.description: Every nourishment received by the body divides into five offspring: breath rising through mind, voice and speech, discharge through power and shame, seed through pleasure of desire, somatic child molded in flesh. Unregenerate man perceives only the last.

teachings.title: The Two Sorrows of the Luminaries
teachings.description: Even sun and moon — most stable, casting no shadow — bear grief: they see King of Darkness enthroned as counterfeit king-face, and Living Soul drawn taut and transferred body to body. Their joy will be permanent at consummation when soul is redeemed and enemy bound.

teachings.title: The Word as Five-Minted Coin
teachings.description: Word born inwardly is shaped by five organs of the mouth into audible likeness, like a coin minted by five artisans (= five faculties) before passing into commerce. Sealed truth circulates between minds as the medium of spiritual exchange.

teachings.title: The New Grain Molded in the Five Elements
teachings.description: New grain molded and adorned in five elements through cooperation of heat (love) and cold (form-holding truth); contrasted with Hyle's energeia inundating elements with shadow and destroying fruits. Same elemental world as contested ground.

teachings.title: The Five Garments and the Pentecost of the Soul
teachings.description: First Man's five garments each holding five inner powers; Call descending and Answer rising joined as twenty characters in twenty members; fifty holy days of fasting (Pentecost) doubled to one hundred as liturgical participation in Call-and-Answer.

teachings.title: The Two Hosts in the Senses
teachings.description: Senses as populated cosmic battlefield: 200,000 divine seals against 200,000 archons of darkness sorted daily by election/purification/inward gathering versus expulsion into Error. Some hosts still concealed awaiting separation.

teachings.title: The Eye as Microcosm
teachings.description: Eye with four visible types and a hidden fifth, doubled into outer/inner fourfolds (visible operation vs. hidden ground); fire and darkness concealed within, discriminated by Living Air as perceiving Spirit. Pupil seeing by day but not by night.

teachings.title: The Five-fold Cosmos and the Five Great Matters
teachings.description: Cosmos held in being only by complete five-fold structure, sustained by bearing-power (Omophoros) and manifest substance (Lord's Wisdom). Five great matters revealed by Apostle to elect: origin, aeons, Light's victory, redemption, binding of evil.

teachings.title: Light Through the Gates of the Firmaments
teachings.description: Light comes forth through gates open firmament by firmament across four climes; rays draw captive light by the hand from threefold strongholds, sort one kind upward to Living Ones and consign the other to whole lower side.

teachings.title: The Three Icons in the Righteous Man
teachings.description: Three discrete degrees of regenerate human: pneumatic icon (New Man, seat of Mind of Light); psychic icon (mediating soul bound to flesh, Old Man); somatic icon (body containing them). Daily soul-cycle of descent and ascent. Virgin of Light as queen, called 'hour of life,' first and last.

teachings.title: The Threefold Prayer and the Threefold Sending
teachings.description: Mother of Life intercedes for First Man fallen into mingling; Father sends Living Spirit who raises and structures; the Five intercede; Third Ambassador chooses out the Living Soul; Jesus the Radiance completes the purpose-of-heart of the elements. Threefold prayer met by threefold sending.

teachings.title: Why Pruning Causes No Pain — Discrete Degrees in the Body
teachings.description: Pain marks where Living Soul is held; outer growths from impurities of food (hair, nails, surface flesh) are not bearers of soul. Body-as-land/members-as-trees analogy classifying growths by response to cutting — discrete classes by life-influx received.

teachings.title: The Soul Loosed in Sickness — Mystical Sight
teachings.description: Mystical seeing in sickness when soul is briefly loosed from body. Typology of seers by duration (one hour vs. delaying at the foot) and direction (Deep vs. Light); seven men and other three categories. Names releasing forth as the Call drawing the soul upward.

teachings.title: The Two Substances and the Work of Separation
teachings.description: Foundational dualism restated as climactic summary: Light and Darkness, beautiful and bitter, life and death — two substances from the beginning. The whole spiritual labor consists in separating the beautiful from the Darkness. Closes the corpus by returning to its opening.

teachings.title: Cherubim, Pillars, and the Yes-Amen as Call and Hearing
teachings.description: Cosmic scaffolding (pillars, Omophoros, four bearing-angels, twelve and twenty-two angels, Five Sons as 'food of the man') held in being by the Calling. The liturgical Yes and Amen identified as Call and Hearing — the two great cosmic operations of redemption that have reigned through all the Aeons.

reading_order_note: The current teaching order is preserved without rearrangement. The natural sequence of the 104 teaching atoms reflects the corpus's own architectural logic: it moves from the foundational dualism of two substances (T1-T3) through the four-fold and five-fold articulations of cosmic descent (T4-T9), the twelvefold completeness of the spiritual man (T10-T15), the cosmic ages and wars (T16-T19), the Father in his inmost (T20-T25), the doctrines of likeness, judgment, and throne (T26-T30), the Living Spirit's building of the cosmic body (T31-T40), the cosmic purifications (T41-T50), the senses and body and Mother's grief (T51-T60), the visible mysteries of sun, moon, and zodiac (T61-T70), the body extended and the soul's operations (T71-T90), and finally the consummating synthesis (T91-T104). Notably, the closing teaching T103 returns to the foundational dualism of T1, framing the corpus as a single arc that ends where it began but at a higher register; T104's identification of the cosmic Yes-and-Amen with the Call and the Hearing serves as the consummating principle of conjunction. Conservative rearrangement was considered for some out-of-order chapter numbering in the source manuscript (e.g., T17 marked as ch. 18, T31 marked as ch. 51, T41 marked as ch. 39) but the spiritual arc reading confirms that the v2 atom sequence is the natural reading order. No teaching has been excluded; even the most heavily damaged fragments (T1, T80, T95, T96, T102, T104) are structurally meaningful and contribute to the architecture as opening, transitional, or closing fragments.

observations.title: The Two Substances Doctrine as Architectural Frame
observations.content: The dualism of Light and Darkness as 'two substances from the beginning' appears at three positions: T1 (Celestial East as foundational opening), T55 (Natural South as the doctrinal premise of the firmament-palace), and T103 (Natural West as the climactic summary). This is not redundancy but architectural framing: the corpus opens, recapitulates at its midpoint, and closes on the same dualism, each iteration at a higher register of articulation. T1 states the cosmic clash; T55 shows the building rising on the mingled state; T103 names the redemptive operation as separation. The three appearances trace the three degrees (celestial, spiritual-into-natural, natural-ultimate).

observations.title: The Cosmos-as-Body Teaching at Three Registers
observations.content: Three teachings articulate the cosmos as the body of a man, each at a different position in the architecture. T38 (Spiritual West) gives the basic anatomy with five watch-stations corresponding to the five faculties. T71 (Natural West, opening) extends this with detailed mapping of cosmic-man head-to-foot, the four sub-cosmoses, the twelve zodiacal members, and the 840 myriads of inner archons. T81 (Natural West, middle) reads the same correspondence through the figure of the pearl in the sea. The three treatments at three discrete positions confirm five-fold constitution as the radial structure of the body and twelve-fold articulation at the cosmic-body's most extended form.

observations.title: The 'Beforehand' Pattern of Providence
observations.content: Three consecutive teachings in Part 9 unfold the doctrine that every separating operation in the natural register was prepared by the Father before its crisis arose. T46 names the formative acts of the Living Spirit; T47 lists seven 'beforehand' clauses (fossae prepared before places of deceit, sea-wall prepared before its boundary, Adamas's foothold prepared before Hyle's fall); T48 extends the foresight pattern to every age of cosmic time. This is a meta-structural rib: it asserts that celestial source-thinking governs the natural register at every step. Providence is not reactive but prepared.

observations.title: Five-fold Constitution as the Most Robust Empirical Pattern
observations.content: Across the entire corpus, five-fold articulation is the dominant radial structure: five members of the trees, five faces, five worlds, five Fathers, five storehouses, five mysteries, five sayings, five awakeners, five salvations, five members of the Father, five emanations, five forms in the King of Darkness, five faculties, five structures in archons, five Men of Radiance, five watch-stations, five somatic substrates, five virtues in the New Man, five lifespans, five weepings, five elemental garments, five works of fire, five works of sun, five offspring of food, five artisans, five powers, five Greatnesses, five Great Matters, five-fold cosmos, five icons. The five-fold pattern far exceeds any other in frequency. This confirms 'five' as constitution operating radially within the twelvefold positions, not as part-count — exactly as the Grand Man hypothesis predicts.

observations.title: Twelvefold Articulation at Specific Positions
observations.content: The twelvefold appears at specific positions where complete articulation is required: twelve hours of the Days (T4 — Celestial South), twelve aeons in the spiritual man (T10 — Celestial West), twelve dignities of cosmos of death (T14), twelve Greatnesses arranged as five (T15 — Celestial West), twelve judges (T28 — Spiritual North), twelve thrones (T29), twelve members of the body (T40 — Spiritual West), twelve zodia (T70 — Natural North), twelve strippings of the Cross of Light (T84), twelve openings of the dragon = seven + five (T88), twelve angels in the cosmic scaffolding (T104). This pattern of twelve-fold articulation confirms the prior structural hypothesis: the twelve positions of the Grand Man are the natural framework for complete cosmic articulation.

observations.title: The Apostle and the Elect Belong to the Natural Register
observations.content: The Apostle (Christ as the Lord's sent revealed truth) and the elect appear specifically in Part 12 (Natural West): the Apostle's letter of peace (T76), the four kingdoms set against the Apostle's saving work (T77-T78), the elect's daily purification (T79), the three icons of the righteous man (T99), and the Apostle's revelation of the five great matters (T97). The Apostle is not present in the celestial or upper-spiritual registers but only in the consummating natural ultimates. This confirms that the Apostle's teaching belongs to the actual application of the prior architecture in the regenerate human's daily life — exactly where the natural-rational interface meets the body of flesh.

observations.title: Size Asymmetry as Doctrinal Feature
observations.content: Part 12 contains 34 teachings — roughly one-third of the corpus — while Parts 1-3 each contain only 3. This is not a defect but a doctrinal feature: ultimates are where heaven exists in concrete form, and the most explicit teaching is required where the regenerative work actually plays out in body, senses, soul, daily food, daily purification, ascent through the luminaries, and the consummation. The natural West carries the weight of teaching matter precisely because it is where the prior architecture has to be applied. Parallel asymmetry: Celestial degree has 15 teachings, Spiritual degree has 25, Natural degree has 64 — a clear progression from inmost to ultimate where the natural carries 60% of the content.

observations.title: The Mother of Life as the Pivot Between Father and Cosmos
observations.content: The Mother of Life appears at architecturally important moments: as the matrix of bringing-forth from which Mother and Spirit proceed (T11, T20, T25); as the corrupt counterpart Hyle's source (T23 — by negative inversion); as the cosmic builder beside the Living Spirit (T55, T100); as the first of the three griefs over the captive Living Soul (T59). This shows the Mother of Life as the divine wisdom-matrix that mediates between the inmost Father and the operative cosmos — present at every level of the architecture as the receptive pole of every emanation. Her appearances span all three degrees, confirming that the Mother is not a localized figure but a degree-spanning principle.

observations.title: The Twelve Greatnesses Arranged as Five — Direct Internal Evidence
observations.content: Teaching 15 explicitly states that the Twelve Greatnesses are arranged as five — the redemptive descent unfolds through five discrete degrees of accommodation. This is the most direct internal statement of the prior architecture's central claim: that twelve positions are realized through five-fold radial constitution. The teaching itself confirms the 12 × 5 structural hypothesis from inside the corpus, not as imposition from outside. Its placement in Part 4 (Celestial West) is also significant: it is the consummating teaching of the celestial degree, where the inmost articulation finds its first ultimates form.

observations.title: Repeated Treatments and Parallel Sequences
observations.content: Several themes receive multiple treatments at different positions, marking architectural ribs across the corpus: the four/twelve cosmic structure (T4 / T14 / T28); the four/five wars and salvations (T17 / T18); the twelve judges and twelve thrones (T28 / T29); the cosmos as body (T38 / T71 / T81); the threefold prayer and threefold sending (T100); the cosmic scaffolding and Yes-Amen (T104). These parallel treatments are not redundancy but reading-instructions: the same architectural pattern is shown at successively lower (or higher) registers, allowing the reader to see how the celestial structure is realized at every degree.
